file: 367 In This Roblox Game You Have to Conquer the Whole World.mp4

lines.t: This new fun game on Roblox makes you take over the whole world.

full.credit: Clips: APEX ROBLOX; RobloMine; NoobBlox (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

sc.big:
THIS NEW FUN
GAME ON ROBLOX

lines.t: You drop your capital anywhere on a real world map. Then you build cities, ports and factories.

full.credit: Clips: APEX ROBLOX; RobloMine; NoobBlox (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: You can make alliances, betray your friends, and if you build a missile silo, launch nukes.

full.credit: Clips: APEX ROBLOX; RobloMine; NoobBlox (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: You win by conquering 80 percent of the world. It came out in September and has almost 80 million visits.

full.credit: Clips: APEX ROBLOX; RobloMine; NoobBlox (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)

lines.t: Would you betray your ally to win?

full.credit: Clips: APEX ROBLOX; RobloMine; NoobBlox (Roblox gameplay, YouTube)
